nh-544g.why: The Bengaluru–Kadapa–Vijayawada greenfield expressway; no package open. OSM maps its alignment, and fill-gaps drew the unbuilt stretches along village and district roads.

nh-150c.why: The Akkalkot–Kurnool greenfield section of the Surat–Chennai corridor, not open. Its unbuilt stretches were drawn along village roads.

nh-130cd.why: The Andhra Pradesh section of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam expressway (catalogued as raipur-visakhapatnam-expressway, under construction).

nh-133b.why: The Sahibganj–Manihari link with its Ganga bridge, still being built.

nh-179b.why: East of Harur the line is the Chennai–Salem greenfield alignment, which has not been built. Its stretches were drawn along village roads and NH 179A.

durg-raipur-arang-expressway.why: OSM's line is the greenfield Durg–Raipur–Arang bypass, still being built; its three holes end in fields with no road.

warangal-khammam-expressway.why: OSM's line is the NH 163G greenfield (Nagpur–Vijayawada corridor), still being built; its four holes end in fields with no road.

chennai-peripherial-ring-road.why: The Chennai Peripheral Ring Road is being built in sections. Section I (Ennore–Thatchur) was drawn along the Ponneri–Minjur road.
